userDecision: Use GPT-6.1 Terra at maximum reasoning for substantial complex coding; optimize repeated context, not artistic ambition.

contextPolicy.handoff: Concise result plus changed files, validation evidence, remaining blockers; link artifacts instead of embedding logs.

executionPolicy.retry: Repeat only when there is new evidence and a specific change; escalate ambiguous artistic decisions to lead.
executionPolicy.quality: Reinvest reduced duplicated context into richer structure, layers and interactions; never simplify art to save tokens. Astra regulates perceptual and practical limits using actual artifacts.
executionPolicy.visualReviewVisibility: Show actual review images and before/after comparisons with observations, judgments and revision decisions to the user. Do not represent private review as user approval.

limits.note: This is a project-local dispatch contract applied by the lead through collaboration tools, not an independent model-routing service.
